decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several models that stayed visible from 2023 to 2024 and fits the firm's stated expansion in organic products, it looks like a core option worth continuing.

Although its website prominence fell from its own page to a general mention, it remains on the market as a multi-variant salami snack close to the core business, so the firm would likely keep the option open a bit longer.

This new 2024 organic boiled sausage sits squarely in the established assortment and was given its own page, so with uncertainty still fresh and holding costs likely modest, management would continue it.
A newly launched organic sliced chicken-breast line with several models strongly matches the firm's organic growth direction and broad-assortment strategy, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.

This 2024 organic herb-coated salami is a narrower flavor extension, so it carries more uncertainty than the main organic lines, but because it is still recent and close to the firm's capabilities, the firm would likely keep it for now.
